summary: The frozen direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) operation is outside this harness’s operational surface. It creates no maintenance obligation for this candidate.

claims.necessity_reason: The complete harness entry constructs an XMLDocument and calls Parse. Its parse and cleanup paths pass identified or existing nodes to XMLDocument::DeleteNode; the changed destructor passes nonnull children to XMLNode::DeleteNode. Fuzzer input cannot make the harness call XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) directly.

before.requirement: For a direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) call, handle the null argument before asserting about the node.
before.reason: The before implementation asserts before its null guard, but the old harness does not make the frozen direct call. Parse checks that an identified node exists before passing it to DeleteNode, and Clear deletes entries only while the unlinked list has entries.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseDeep exits when Identify supplies no node; its error deletion receives the identified node.
Clear calls DeleteNode on an indexed unlinked entry only while the list is nonempty.

after.requirement: For a direct XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) call, return before asserting about the node.
after.reason: The after implementation returns before its assertion. The old harness still makes no direct null call; Parse and Clear supply nodes, while the changed XMLNode destructor deletes children only inside a nonnull loop.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseDeep checks for an absent identified node before its error deletion call.
Clear deletes an indexed unlinked entry only while the list is nonempty.
The changed destructor calls XMLNode::DeleteNode only for a nonnull current child.

claims.comparison_reason: The source changes the result of the same direct null call, but that call is outside this entry’s operational surface on both sides. The old harness has no constraint that blocks a required instance of this frozen operation.
